datasets.name: Bellandur Lake, Bengaluru (illustrative)
datasets.description: Illustrative lake with a stable outline: aquatic vegetation spreads over open water while the surroundings are built over. Changes inside the lake are kept separate from the surroundings.
datasets.simulated_label: Illustrative Dataset: a generated demonstration layer, not satellite imagery.
datasets.source: Generated by the reusable pipeline app.explorer.atlas; no satellite data are used for these layers.

variables.label: lake extent (open water and aquatic vegetation)

rules: The lake outline is nearly constant (a small shore sector is built over, about 2 percent of the lake).
Aquatic vegetation expands in the shallow zones, replacing open water cover while the lake extent stays nearly the same.
Built-up area grows around village nuclei and an east-west corridor, outside the lake zone only.

datasets.name: Bellandur and east Bengaluru (GHSL built-up)
datasets.description: Built-up surface from the Global Human Settlement Layer at epochs 2000, 2010 and 2020, reclassified to built-up / not built-up.
datasets.source: European Commission JRC, Global Human Settlement Layer (GHS-BUILT-S R2023A)
datasets.format: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (derived from the original official file)

provenance.note: GHSL is a modelled product built from Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery. Epoch years are not acquisition dates.
